title: se implementation scratchpad - starlight federal
content:
Notes to self / SE scratchpad for Starlight Federal onboarding

Context:
- Customer: Starlight Federal (regional bank, regulated financials)
- Engagement: Redwood Private (VPC + on-prem option) evaluation, initial Dedicated pilot for production traffic burst testing
- Primary contacts: Alan Whitmore (IT), Maria Gomez (Security)

High-level goals:
- Deliver a POC on Redwood Dedicated with bank-grade network segmentation and KMS integration by end of Q1 pilot
- Validate latency SLA under peak batch loads (target p95 < 120ms for interactive flows)
- Enable audit logging to their Splunk instance and support SOC review

Meeting notes 2026-02-18:
- Alan: wants clear doc showing network topology and where customer-managed KMS sits. Air-gap option will require offline installer (discussion for later).
- Maria: compliance requires TLS mutual auth between Redwood control plane and their VPC; also need HSM-backed keys for production
- Action: get security design + sample Terraform for VPC peering and route tables

Immediate TODOs (priority order):
1) Draft network/security diagram for Starlight (include NAT, VPN, peering, route restrictions) - due 2026-02-24 (ACTION: Jordan)
2) Create KMS/HSM integration note: supported providers, required APIs, sample key rotation policy - due 2026-02-26 (ACTION: Priya)
3) Config template for Dedicated capacity (GPU type, instance count, expected throughput) - rough numbers for POC (ACTION: Marcus)
4) Add Splunk audit forwarder config and sample log mapping (fields: request_id, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms, user_id) - due 2026-02-28
5) Prepare brief for legal/security review with required artifacts list - due 2026-03-03

Implementation notes / config fragments:
- Recommended Dedicated pool for POC:
  - model: redwood/gptq-7b-v2 (quantized inference variant)
  - GPUs: 4 x A10G (or equivalent) to hit target p95 under concurrent 75 users (estimate)
  - autoscale: enable burst to 6 nodes, cold-start warmup 90s (tunable)

- Network setup (customer VPC):
  - Option A: VPC peering (preferred for latency) + restricted subnets for inference nodes.
  - Option B: Site-to-site VPN if peering not allowed.
  - Required ports: 443 (TLS control/ingress), 10250-10255 (cluster health, k8s internal if using private k8s), outbound to Redwood control plane management CIDR (provided)
  - mTLS: customer will present certs; need to add cert thumbprint to onboarding manifest

- KMS/HSM integration checklist:
  - Supported: AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault (HSM-backed).
  - For HSM-backed keys: need PKCS#11 endpoint or vendor-managed HSM connector. Provide sample config: key_alias: starlight-prod-llm, rotation_period: 30d, owner_contact: security@starlight.com
  - Must include audit logs of key usage forwarded to customer Splunk (ensure mapping)

- Logging / observability:
  - Event fields to forward: timestamp, request_id, model_version, route, tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms, status_code, user_id (anonymize PII)
  - Splunk HF endpoint: https://splunk.starlight-federal.internal:8088 (placeholder; confirm with Alan)
  - Retention: customer wants 90 days on hot store, 1 year cold - map to Redwood retention tiers (note: extra cost)

Open questions / dependencies:
- Q1: Can Starlight provide HSM connector for production? If not, propose Vault+HSM via managed partner. (Maria to confirm 2026-02-23)
- Q2: Does Legal need a dedicated Data Processing Addendum for pilot? (triggered by PII in logs) - reach out to Legal CS.
- Q3: Which internal teams need access to dashboards? Provide list of emails for RBAC.

Risk notes:
- Network approval delays are most common blocker (need early engagement with their cloud/network team)
- HSM availability could push to managed Vault option causing extra ops overhead

Quick runbook for POC deploy (steps):
- Step 0: Validate customer pre-reqs (VPC CIDRs, peering allowed, KMS details)
- Step 1: Provision Dedicated pool (initial 4 A10G), apply network policies, ensure subnets map
- Step 2: Install Splunk forwarder sidecar on inference nodes or configure log shipper to HF endpoint
- Step 3: Configure KMS plugin and test key decrypt/encrypt for sample payloads (use staging key)
- Step 4: Run load test with 100 concurrent sessions for 10min, collect p50/p95/p99
- Step 5: Capture tokens cost and produce cost estimate for monthly run rate

Notes to self (short):
- Check PR #456 for updated deploy scripts (contains splunk and kms templates)
- Get contact for Starlight cloud infra: alan.whitmore@starlightfederal.com (verify)
- Keep the POC minimal: aim to avoid on-prem offline installer unless absolutely necessary

Next meeting planned: 2026-03-02 (internal prep 2026-02-28)

Quick links / refs:
- Confluence: /display/SE/Starlight+Federal+Onboarding (CONFLUENCE-4321)
- Jira: SERV-1287 (health checks + splunk integration)
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy-configs/pull/456

End of scratchpad.
